Name: Reward Detector
Author: Cseron
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Reward Detector[/b][/size]
Craft information accessories, carry them in your backpack, and follow the markers to rewards which already exist.[/center]

[b]What it does[/b]

Reward Detector adds eleven inexpensive craftable devices. A carried device draws colored outlines around matching targets on screen and grouped arrows toward matching targets outside the screen.

It is not a predictor. The mod never reveals random drops, hidden ladder locations, chest contents, secret notes, or other outcomes which the game has not created yet.

[b]Live filters[/b]

Press [b]Left Shift + V[/b] to open the grouped target menu. You can enable or disable each target type immediately—for example, hide copper while keeping iron and gold visible—or show/hide every currently available category at once. Locked rows name the base detector they require. A filter does not unlock anything by itself: the corresponding device must be in one of the 36 backpack slots. A device stored in a chest is inactive.

[b]Detectors[/b]

• Forager's Charm — vanilla ground finds, fruit left in the fruit-bat cave, spring onions, ginger, ripe berry bushes, and loose mine and Volcano Dungeon finds.
• Dowsing Twig — artifact spots and seed spots.
• Ore Compass — vanilla copper, iron, gold, iridium, and radioactive ore nodes.
• Gem Lens — vanilla gem, diamond, and mystic nodes.
• Resource Resonator — vanilla coal, geode, bone, clay, cinder shard, and mussel nodes, each with its own live filter.
• Water Locator — fishing bubbles, fish frenzies, and panning spots.
• Cave Navigator — revealed ladders and shafts, breakable containers, unused coal carts, and Beach Farm supply crates.
• Threat Sensor — active hostile monsters.
• Field Identifier, Mine Analyzer, and Reward Detector combine the earlier devices to save backpack space.

[b]Progression[/b]

Every recipe is known from the start. The first devices use materials available in the opening days; combined devices require progressively better bars. Exact recipes are listed in the included README and in the crafting menu.

[b]Requirements[/b]

• Stardew Valley 1.6.15
• SMAPI 4.5.2
• Generic Mod Config Menu is optional

[b]Installation[/b]

Vortex: click [b]Mod Manager Download[/b], install and enable the mod in Vortex, then launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.

Manual: extract the [b]RewardDetector[/b] folder into [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b], then launch the game through SMAPI.

[b]Compatibility[/b]

The mod uses explicit vanilla IDs for mineral nodes and ground finds, plus an explicit vanilla monster class list. Player-grown wild-seed crops, unknown modded targets, ordinary stones, and event/festival monsters are excluded. Other tracking mods are not patched or suppressed, so overlapping markers can appear if both are enabled. Individual categories can be disabled through the live menu.

[b]Languages[/b]

English and Russian are included.

[b]Original art[/b]

All eleven detector item icons were created specifically for Reward Detector using an OpenAI ImageGen concept workflow followed by local pixel cleanup and assembly into original 16×16 sprites. Off-screen arrows reference the vanilla sprite of the target itself; visible targets use plain outlines without icon badges. Random or potential drops are never shown, vanilla textures are not redistributed, and no third-party mod sprites are included.
